name: Emily Kame Kngwarreye (Yam Dreaming)
description: Fuselage: Forward fuselage white with standard 'QANTAS' titles; from behind the forward door to the tail the fuselage is covered in deep red/ochre and orange with dense white dot clusters forming a cellular yam-root pattern (from the 1991 painting 'Yam Dreaming'). Cheatlines: None. Tail: Qantas red fin with the white flying kangaroo; the lower fin blends into the dotted artwork. Engines: White/gray. Winglets: Raked tips. Titles: Black 'QANTAS' forward. Artwork: Adapted by Balarinji. Colors hex: approximate.
notes: 787 fleet serves LAX and Perth-LHR; exact current routing varies.
